_comment: Locked references for every Medallions generation. Lee approved the portrait finish (KSTY-87) and the crests (KSTY-88) on 2026-11-15; see handoffs/medallions/COMMON.md. copy is the committed 512 px copy; sha256 is the Higgsfield original's. historicalWords lists words of the setting a locked prompt carried when KSTY-88 sent it, before tables.py was reworded; a locked anchor is never sent again.

badge.prompt: Repaint the reference character as a tiny-size game icon meant to be read at 24 pixels wide. Same character, same colours, same painted style, but: face only, tightly framed, the face filling 80 percent of the square and centred; very large simple shapes; only four or five value groups; a strong dark outline around the head silhouette; the eyes as two bright glowing amber shapes; remove all small detail, texture, scratches, hair strands and background elements. Plain dark charcoal background. No text, no border, no frame.

crestStyle.prompt:
Heraldic crest for a fantasy RPG game interface: one ornate shield emblem, centred, seen straight on, isolated on a fully transparent background.

Race heraldry (mountain dwarf clans): a broad, squat hexagonal shield of hammered dark bronze framing a slab of carved grey granite; thick angular knotwork engraved along the bronze border; heavy round rivets; a stylised mountain peak with a small anvil forged into the top of the frame; two small blood-red garnets set at the left and right corners.

Class emblem (shaman, storm caller): in the centre field a carved stone totem crowned with forked lightning, ringed by four small elemental runes for earth, fire, water and air, inlaid in deep cobalt-blue enamel with a soft electric-blue inner glow, and a bright sapphire set at the totem's heart.

Finish: premium hand-painted fantasy game-art icon with rich materials: polished bronze edges with warm specular highlights, glossy enamel, cut gems catching the light, depth from bevels and recessed engraving, a cool rim light from the upper left, deep contact shadows. Crisp clean silhouette with a thin dark outline so it still reads at 64 pixels. The shield fills about 80 percent of the canvas height and is perfectly left-right symmetrical.

No text, no letters, no numbers, no faces, no characters, no scenery, no background, no cast shadow outside the shield.

portrait.prompt: Hand-painted fantasy game portrait icon. Head-and-shoulders bust, three-quarter view turned slightly to the left, the face filling the central 65 percent of the square so it survives a circular crop. Bold, instantly readable silhouette; clean crisp edges with no fuzz; a few large shapes, not fine noise. Warm key light from the upper left, cool cyan rim light on the right edge, strong value contrast on the face and eyes. Saturated but limited palette. Stylised painterly rendering with sharp edges, like premium MMO class art. Plain deep charcoal-to-black radial background. No text, no letters, no border, no frame, no ring, no logo, no watermark. Character: a stout, broad-shouldered mountain dwarf shaman, a man with a thick braided copper-red beard bound with stone rings, a grey wolf-pelt hood, a necklace of carved stone and bone totems, faint blue storm light crackling in his eyes and around one raised fist.
